scope: Finite differences from JPL quantity31 under explicitly different conventions; not absolute accuracy or a certified bound.
knownDifferences: Engine has no solar gravitational light deflection; JPL observer apparent quantities do.
Engine Moon geometry carries neither light-time nor aberration correction; JPL observer quantities do.
JPL IAU76/80 ecliptic reduction differs from the engine rotation model.
Mars through Pluto references below are planetary-system barycenters, not guaranteed physical body centers.
UTC-looking input labels are synthetic UT1 with TT minus UT1 pinned to69 seconds; they are not claims of historical physical UTC.
